## Cannonade Golem (CR 17)

**XP** 102,400  
N Gargantuan construct  
**Init** +6; **Senses** darkvision 60 ft., low-light vision; Perception +2  


**Defense**


**AC** 34, touch 12, flat-footed 28 (+6 Dex, +22 natural, -4 size)  
**hp** 170 (20d10+60)  
**Fort** +6 **Ref** +12 **Will** +8  
**DR** 15/adamantine; Immune construct traits, magic  


**Offense**


**Speed** 30 ft.  
**Melee** 2 slams +34 (8d6+18)  
**Ranged** cannon +22/+17 (12d6+6/19-20/x4)  
**Space** 20 ft.; **Reach** 20 ft.  
**Special Attacks** cannon  


**Statistics**


**Str** 46, **Dex** 22, Con—, Int—, **Wis** 15, **Cha** 2  
**Base Atk** +20; **CMB** +42; **CMD** 58  
**Feats** Improved Critical (cannon)  
**SQ** alloyed, blasting critical, gun training  


**Special Abilities**


**Alloyed (Ex)** A cannonade golem’s slam and cannon attacks count as adamantine, cold iron, and silver for the purpose of overcoming damage reduction.  

**Blasting Critical (Ex)** When a cannonade golem confirms a critical hit with a slam attack, it can make one cannon attack against that target as a free action (as long as the cannon is loaded).  

**Cannon (Ex)** The golem’s cannon has a range increment of 100 feet and deals 12d6 points of bludgeoning and piercing damage on a hit with a x4 critical modifier. Attacks against targets within 100 feet are ranged touch attacks.
